verdict.rationale: Salesmate serves an llms.txt at salesmate.io/llms.txt, so an agent can be pointed at it, but its content as evidenced is marketing-level feature descriptions rather than developer or API guidance. Probes show the API docs site has no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: llms.txt or agent-oriented content for the API docs, markdown-rendered docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and evidence that the llms.txt covers technical usage beyond product feature summaries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: API and integration support for extended workflows
Update CRM records, fields, and activities autonomously without manual intervention
